summary: Verified the account-keyed login lockout fix and full API/UI regressions. All 20 backend tests passed: public lockout returned 401 x5 then 429, successful admin login reset the counter, lead/auth regressions passed, and direct FastAPI CORS retained its explicit allowlist. Landing, booking persistence, admin login/dashboard/status refresh/filter/logout flows passed with no application errors.
critical_code_review_comments: login() now uses the stable normalized account key acct:{email}; public tests confirmed the sixth failure is blocked and a valid login removes that account's counter.

FastAPI CORSMiddleware reads the explicit CORS_ORIGINS allowlist with credentials enabled. Direct-backend allowed/rejected-origin checks passed. The public edge still emits wildcard ACAO, confirmed as environmental and intentionally not re-flagged as an application defect.

Admin startup logic updates an existing bcrypt password hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes; the persisted admin hash starts with $2b$, and login sets both access and refresh cookies HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=None.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_QA_ backend lead and one TEST_QA_UI_ITER3 booking lead for persistence testing; removed all TEST_QA_ leads and all login_attempts records afterward and verified zero remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 is green. Public auth tests cover exact 401,401,401,401,401,429 lockout behavior and the 3 failures -> success -> 3 failures reset sequence. UI booking/admin flow passed after waiting for dashboard API loading to complete. /app/auth_testing.md remains absent; credentials came from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Public wildcard CORS is edge-injected and out-of-scope; direct app allowlisting passed.
rca_of_the_issue: The previous ingress-IP partitioning defect is resolved by keying login_attempts solely on the normalized account identifier. All public attempts now hit one MongoDB record, and successful login deletes that same record.
